title: Experiment registry: Kaede vs Northwind, field-by-field
excerpt: Northwind records a pre-registered stopping rule and a named decision owner for every test. We record neither. Proposal: add both fields; I've filled them in retroactively for Q1.

title: Q2 pricing test: results and what I'd change
excerpt: The 3% increase held SMB retention flat (n=4,120 per arm). Enterprise arm was underpowered; next time I'd stratify by contract length up front rather than post hoc.

title: One-owner pilot: design and month-1 results
excerpt: Hypothesis: lead time is driven by ownership ambiguity, not role definitions. Two services, one accountable owner each. PR-to-prod lead time fell from 6.1 to 3.4 days. Confounders: both services had recent test coverage work.

title: FY26 pricing analytics roadmap (draft for exec review)
excerpt: Three priorities for the Tokyo team: elasticity by segment, a self-serve cohort tool for PMs, and a junior analyst rotation. Staffing assumes I stay as lead through FY27.

title: Junior analyst program: outline
excerpt: Twelve-week rotation across growth, pricing and finance. Weekly office hours. I'll run cohort one myself.
